plot.description: Players begin their journey in Woking, observing a mysterious meteor shower that leads to the discovery of a Martian cylinder. They must gather information from local astronomers and scientists like Ogilvy and Henderson and explore the surrounding fields. Critical decisions involve whether to inform the authorities or to investigate the cylinder on their own. Players may encounter curious onlookers, manage their fear, and deal with the panic as they try to uncover what lies inside the cylinder. The dangers grow as the cylinder begins to open, hinting at the terrifying Martians within.
plot.title: The Falling Star

plot.description: Continuing the narrative, players must handle the chaos following the opening of the cylinder as the first Martian emerges. The chapter revolves around escaping the devastating heat-ray unleashed on the crowd and finding a way to safety. Players can choose to assist others in their flight or prioritize their survival. They will gather essential items to help with their escape, like food and medical supplies, while learning about the Martians' destructive capabilities.
plot.title: First Contact

plot.description: This chapter places players in a militarily occupied Woking, where they must navigate the town amid rising tension from military forces preparing to confront the Martians. Players will be tasked with making alliances, gathering intelligence about Martian movements, and determining the best path for escape or resistance. The landscape is littered with the remnants of battle and panic, and players must avoid Martian patrols while seeking refuge in a local inn or amongst the ruins of homes.
plot.title: Under Siege

plot.description: As urban chaos unfolds, players must help families evacuated from their homes. The story focuses on finding safe passage away from Woking amid the Martians' siege. Players must decide whether to embark on an organized military evacuation or risk crossing paths with Martian war machines. Key choices involve rescuing individuals in distress and deciding what supplies to carry. Each decision has consequences that impact the survival of characters involved.
plot.title: The Great Retreat

plot.description: Now far from Woking, players face the ruins of destroyed cities where the Martian red weed spreads. They encounter other survivors and must decide whether to join forces or pursue solitary survival. The eerie landscape filled with abandoned homes thrusts players into moral dilemmas—will they hoard supplies for themselves or share with others in need? Players will witness the impact of the Martian invasion on human life and develop strategies to evade Martians while scavenging for food.
plot.title: Darkness and Despair

plot.description: Discover advanced Martian war machines while exploring the outskirts of London. With new intel about the enemy's weaknesses becoming available, players must strategize an offensive—either sabotaging machines or launching attacks against Martian positions. The chapter focuses on stealth and creativity as players gather resources and decide how best to respond when facing the fearsome tripods. Choices can lead to multiple outcomes, affecting the level of devastation or resistance encountered.
plot.title: The Martian Machines

plot.description: In a final confrontation, players must either band together with other survivors for one last stand against the Martians or execute an escape strategy to save as many lives as possible. The climax involves intense conflict, the propagation of hope, and the pivotal discoveries that lead to the Martians' downfall. As the battle rages, players navigate between frantic escapes and bold counterattacks, ultimately determining the fate of humanity in this desperate fight for survival.
plot.title: The Last Stand

title: Invasion of the Martians
world:
Set in the late 19th century, the world of this adventure game is one of impending doom as Martians from the cold, distant planet of Mars begin their invasion of Earth. With humanity oblivious to the threats from above, Martian scouts utilize advanced technology to plan their conquest, bringing chaos to the once-peaceful towns of England. Earth is depicted as lush and vibrant, filled with ordinary lives, yet now it becomes a battlefield where survival is paramount. Various factions emerge, from scientists trying to understand the Martians to military forces scrambling to defend humanity against an unrelenting foe, plunging society into turmoil.

As the Martians execute their invasion using fearsome heat-rays and biological warfare, meteoric cylinders become the harbingers of destruction. Players must navigate through this chaos, making crucial decisions to avoid Martian detection, communicate with others, and gather resources to fight back. The rules of this world are simple: trust no Martian, survive at all costs, and utilize wit and courage to forge alliances or face the wrath of extraterrestrial beings intent on exterminating humankind.
